purpose: Two-handed idle, decoded in-repository rather than in Blender

skeleton.note: The same file g2-3-1-input-manifest.json froze. The greatsword idle and the guard pack were baked against one skeleton, which is why their bone offsets are identical.

pairValidation.evidenceTheSharedTracksAreCorrect: All 23 SKYRIM_BONE_RETARGETS bind offsets match shd_blockidle's to every printed decimal, except handslot.r (the WEAPON node), which a two-handed clip is expected to place differently. Bind offsets are the skeleton's own bone lengths and would scramble under any shift in track numbering.
